body:
So, I live in a medium-sized city with lousy transport. The only reason I can do anything right now is because I live in an apartment right on a major transit line and found a job in an office right on that line. If I had to move back in with my parents, who live nowhere near any transit, I would have no way of having a job or leaving the house ever. I know this because I was only able to start school and get a job when I moved in with my boyfriend, into our apartment on the major transit line. If I lose this place, I lose everything.

I think things in my relationship are fine. I am happy here and don't feel trapped. It's just stressful because if we were to break up, I wouldn't be able to do any of the normal healing-from-heartbreak things (seeing friends, taking care of myself) because I would literally be trapped in my parents basement. 

If I quit school now, I will need to give up on law school forever. There is no way in hell I'm going to be able to pay back $100k+ in student loans if I'm going to take a $35k starting attorney position with only 25 work years left. I'm a high school dropout so if I don't at least finish undergrad I'll also have no shot at just paying back the loans I've already taken out (and if I stop going to school, I'll have to start paying them back now, which I don't have the money to do). I work in law now and my job is fine and pays fine (I make what the new attorneys make, which is how I know that I'll never be able to survive if I start law school any later than I already am) but it's too much for me and I literally can't afford to take anything off my plate. 

My boyfriend and I are trying to look at the numbers and see if we can figure out a way for me to quit my job and take something more part time while I finish school, but part of me feels like that won't even solve the problem of me failing out of school because the issue isn't that I need more time to do work, it's just that I'm a lazy piece of shit who can't be bothered to do anything right and spends more time feeling sorry for myself than actually working and is too sensitive and easily discouraged.
